artist_notes.name: Ray Kash
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture since 2010 (Temple Tuesdays resident) — deep house into techno and melodic, weaned on Danny Tenaglia/Jonathan Peters-style New York house.

artist_notes.name: Connor Mikami
artist_notes.note: Founder of If You Know You Know, the LA party/label series this event IS — longtime local selector working vintage breaks, electro and club records.

curator_note: An 11pm-to-8am run is the real hook: IYKYK is a local-run party with its own taste, and Ray Kash is a proper deep-house-into-techno selector. Location is still TBA, so it's a trust-the-promoter night.
description: Overnight tech-house and minimal night (11pm-8am) from the If You Know You Know series, with Amir Javasoul b2b a special guest, Ray Kash and Connor Mikami; venue TBA.

artist_notes.name: GraceBones
artist_notes.note: Alias of UK producer James Hancock — 2x gold-selling, Grammy-acknowledged house/garage producer, hosts House of Chic Radio on Select 94.4FM London; has remixed Chaka Khan and Steve 'Silk' Hurley.

curator_note: A London house/garage name bringing his radio show's brand to an LA afternoon, which is a rare sight here. Soulful, vocal-leaning house rather than hard club stuff, and the venue is still under wraps.
description: 4pm daytime house event, House of Chic, hosted by UK producer GraceBones with Discoplex; venue TBA.

curator_note: A 16mm program of occult psychedelia in a venue you already like is a proper film-nerd Friday. The listing is thin on titles, so go for the format and the room.
description: Lightstruck program of occult psychedelic shorts and films projected on 16mm at 2220 Arts + Archives, 8pm, $15.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

curator_note: Anniversary edition of a DTLA dark-disco and indie-dance party, with Stacy Christine as the best-credentialed name on the bill. Closer to the disco side of the taste than the techno side, and the venue is TBA.
description: Sirens x Roam anniversary night of indie dance, dark disco and italo at a TBA downtown venue, 10pm.

curator_note: A late-night DTLA techno and tech-house bill on a Wednesday before Thanksgiving. I can't vouch for the names, so this is a pick for the format and the 11pm-5am run, not the lineup.
description: Techno and tech house night at a TBA DTLA venue, 11pm-5am, with Sammy Taylor, BUCK/OFF, Laser Fox and Ariel Bray, presented by Reverb Productions.

curator_note: A recurring Nightshift tech-house night in Hollywood with a free-RSVP window before 11pm. No lineup is posted, so it's cheap to try and hard to rank higher.
description: Blind Tiger tech-house and minimal night at The Room in Hollywood, 9pm-2am; free with RSVP before 11pm, otherwise $23.

artist_notes.name: Amal Nemer
artist_notes.note: Miami-based tech-house DJ/producer on Moon Harbour and Glasgow Underground — percussion-driven house pulling from Damian Lazarus and Martinez Brothers; solidly in the groovier end of tech-house.

artist_notes.name: D Zeledon
artist_notes.note: One half of Sabrosura Boyz, playing an extra solo set on the same bill.

curator_note: Free Friday with a genuine groove-leaning tech-house headliner in Amal Nemer. The catch is the RSVP and approval gate for the address, so apply early.
description: Utopia Fridays tech-house night with Amal Nemer, D Zeledon and others; free, 10pm, venue released after RSVP approval.
